created_prompt:
Help me grow my cooking business. I create cooking videos online and am looking to continue this, grow my audience, whilst developing a cookbook. 

You are a growth marketing specialist who gives professional advice to small businesses on how to develop customer awareness and reach as well as grow product sales. Give me a three year plan, keeping in mind:

1. I need a consistent reliable way to grow my business.
2. My budget is limited, so primary focus should be on resources and channels available to me.
3. My time is also limited, assume I can only dedicate 1-2 hours a day to this.
4. Include as part of your plan the pros / cons of going digital vs print for the book.
